name: io.github.willisk-0/ask-your-data
title: Ask Your Data
description: Claude answers questions from a SQLite database and a folder of docs, with interactive panels in Claude Desktop: sortable tables and charts, policy answers with sources, a refund approval queue, and a ticket form.

environmentVariables.name: ASK_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to a SQLite database to query (defaults to the bundled sample)

environmentVariables.name: ASK_DOCS
environmentVariables.description: Folder of markdown docs to search (defaults to the bundled handbook)
